six_answers.oracle_correctability: Supported at rho .02 and K10 in both directions; strong spatial, temporal and joint gains under GT objectives. This is finite oracle evidence, not unlabeled TTA.
six_answers.architecture_alignment: Supported locally: spatial native gradient energy overwhelmingly in appearance, temporal gradient entirely in motion; swapped one-step probes much weaker. Not global subspace exclusivity.
six_answers.gain_preservation: Spatial+temporal constraint identical to unconstrained spatial with zero activation; temporal+spatial retains 82.823% positive HC time gain and 100% Vid time gain. Vid temporal constraint inactive.
six_answers.collateral: HC temporal spatial protection improves original-interval box self-IoU .955245 to .989212 but reduces tube gain and increases >5pp video harm count 1 to 2. Self-consistency does not establish task safety. Selective versus joint is domain dependent and schedule-confounded.
six_answers.vulnerability: No supported positive within-domain relation to spatial or joint correctability; broad CIs prevent claiming universal independence. Do not use this VA as gate or corrective direction. In Vid, correlation with baseline spatial error is negative.
six_answers.causal_ASA: Eligible cases weaken dominant A/H cancellation: attention-only query effect approximates joint effect, feature-only is smaller. Query relative-norm changes are nonzero but downstream effect attenuated; stage1 routed final unchanged and stage2 mean self-vIoU >.996. Supports local functional redundancy, not universal irrelevance.

scope: 64 historically exposed development parents; GT used deliberately for oracle; no fresh-test efficacy claim
